subject: Banking
title: The European Central Bank
description: A fast breakdown of The European Central Bank for builders.

hook.text: The ECB sets monetary policy for 20 countries using one currency.

buildup.text: Created in 1998, the ECB manages the euro. Its primary mandate is price stability, targeting inflation near 2%.

discovery.text: The ECB's Governing Council has 26 members: 6 Executive Board members and 20 national central bank governors.

twist.text: What's right for Germany's economy is often wrong for Greece's.

climax.text: The ECB manages a monetary union without a fiscal union. One currency, 20 budgets, and no easy way to reconcile them.

punchline.text: One rate for 20 economies. The ECB manages an impossible compromise.

quiz.question: How many countries does the ECB set monetary policy for?
